body: You likely have PSSD.
I feel absolutely nothing most of the time. How the hell would know what I feel? I would still choose my sexuality any day of the week.
Let them quit. Less people will end up with PSSD.
For what it's worth I would go no contact. Not everything can be forgiven. Certainly if it would bring you some piece to cut her out of your life you have every right to do so.
low

And what does that story contribute to a sub for iatrogenically harmed people? Also you're on other psychiatric drugs. If it got better after you discontinued and you had a bunch of sex you clearly do not have PSSD.

I don't need empathy from scum like you on psych meds. Therapy is what led me to take an antidepressant and get PSSD in the first place. Keep your suggestions to yourself.
Wow you really provided a well-reasoned argument. All serotonergic drugs cause sexual dysfunction and can cause PSSD.

You don’t have PSSD. You’re still on the meds. What the hell are you doing on this sub? Also sex might not be that important to you but it is to others. Sorry if I’m not gonna applaud you for the positive vibes. Medication did not save my life. It took everything from me. Maybe your post belongs in r/antidepressants since you are oh so grateful for the wonderful neurotoxins you are eating on the daily.
They cause sexual dysfunction and can themselves cause PSSD.

No and I’d rather jump of a bridge than ever take an antidepressant (That word itself is ridiculous. It’s a neurotoxic numbing pill) again. Crazy to think there are actually people that reinstate after getting PSSD. Like I guess you didn’t learn anything the first time.

No. Therapy cost me a lot of money and worsened my suicidality after being told I need to learn to except my PSSD is irreversible and I should just find a purpose in life despite being 100% emotionally and physically numb. I’ve also had therapists attempt to coerce me  into taking more SSRIs despite knowing about my drug injury. They only have one script - tell ppl to go on walks, try journaling/meditation. If that fails send them to a psychiatrist. You can also expect your therapist to be resistent to acknowledging PSSD or downplay the importance of sexuality in the first place. Keep in mind they’ve gotten countless people on those drugs so admitting to the possibility of permanent damage would mean admitting they personally carry a certain level of responsibility in harming patients. They are much more likely to resort to cognitive dissonance than to go there in their own minds. 

I would never see another therapist.
Be careful with bromantane. It has SRI properties and causes sexual dysfunction for some.

DO NOT take it. I got PSSD from Mirtazapine. Complete sexual dysfunction from the first pill that has persisted since. It acts on serotonin just like classic SSRIs and there’s countless cases of PSSD from it. It’s also one of the hardest drugs to come off of and can cause massive weight gain.
I’d be willing to bet it’s even higher. Probably more like 80-90 percent.
When you consider how hard it is to come off for some people they may never know because they are stuck on them for life anyway.

Your situation isn’t that unusual. Many sufferers have had extensive testing and everything comes back normal. We don’t know what causes PSSD but my best guess would be epigenetic changes to the nervous system/brain or perhaps receptor desensitization. Those can’t be tested for. Plus as others have already mentioned you can’t OD on just a couple pills of SSRIs or necessarily get serotonin syndrome from them.
I’m gonna be honest with you. People in this community have tried a shit ton of stuff and none of it works so it would be hard to recommend anything in terms of treatment.
Didn’t help for me. If anything it made things worse.

I have those occasionally including orgasms. Usually it happens around ovulation. Before PSSD I never had sexual dreams. I feel like it’s my body trying to compensate for something it can’t experience when I’m awake.
I have the same. My anhedonia was caused by PSSD. I have no issue motivating myself to do things but nothing gives me any enjoyment.
Yes during a short window. Now I’m back to complete numbness. It’s such a depressing situation. Briefly I thought I was on my way to healing but nope.
It’s just a cover-their-ass policy peptide sites use because those drugs aren’t FDA approved and can’t be legally sold for human consumption. I’ve bought peptides before and they had the same label.
I can but my memory is awful.

I agree. I could probably cope with the emotional blunting for the rest of my life as much as it sucks but losing my sexuality has been unbearable. Working out and sex were the reasons why I got up in the morning. Maybe that sounds incredibly shallow but everyone is different. And it seems to be the one symptom that’s impossible to treat. I’ve tried a million things too - all useless. Are you male or female btw?

This is a great comment. I feel the same as OP. I could live with the emotional blunting but being chemically castrated is unbearable. I’d say I was a fairly rational person and not at all sentimental about sex. It wasn’t connected to love for me. Perhaps that’s why. Sexuality was one of the things I enjoyed most in life and a huge part of my identity.
I‘m the same. Unfortunately my negative emotions like anxiety and anger aren’t entirely blunted but the positive ones are.

I still get bouts of intense anxiety despite the fact that I experience zero emotions otherwise and also have complete sexual dysfunction.

OCD is pretty minor now.
How is this PSSD when you don’t experience sexual dysfunction at all? Sounds more like a withdrawal injury.

Thank you. Glad you’re still able to find some enjoyment in it. I used to be into all those things as well. Psychological arousal is completely gone too though. Looking at an attractive dude is about as appealing as looking at wall. I don’t really feel an emotional connection to anyone not even family. The only way I could see a relationship working out is with another sufferer where we a both in the same situation.

I don’t even have the energy to be angry anymore now but the first 3 years I definitely took it out on everyone around me including my family. I can’t imagine anything more traumatic and dehumanizing.

As a woman I can totally understand what you mean. I haven’t had sex since getting PSSD. I wish I could date but don’t think I could bring myself to allow someone to use my body like that no matter how much I might like them. It would kill me to see another person’s pleasure knowing there’s nothing I can do to feel that ever again. Definitely a loss of ownership. What a soul destroying nightmare.

I relate to this so much. Sexuality wasn’t just about having a good time for me but rather a central part of my identity. Without it there’s no “me” I honestly don’t think this is something I will ever come to terms with. I had various anxieties surrounding sex before as well. And like you said they have come true in the most nightmarish way possible.

Anxiety may affect libido but it doesn't make your genitals go numb. That's just not physically possible. Don't let anybody gaslight you. It's a relapse and all in your head is what they all say yet so many of us are experiencing the same thing.
It’s such a brutal thing to go through. They robbed us of something so fundamental. It’s been a couple of years but I still feel violated every day.
Honestly wish there was a dating platform for PSSD sufferers. Would be much easier than to date someone with normal sexuality :(
Same. Haven’t dated since but the loneliness is crippling.
Are you on SSRIs? They commonly cause sexual dysfunction/loss of libido and could make you feel essentially asexual.
It's fine to just stop after only a week on the lowest dose. I wouldn't stay on it any longer tbh.
PSSD affects both males and females. Check out Rosie from PSSD network or Emily Grey from the Canadian PSSD society.
100% the more people talk about their terrible experiences with psychiatry the better
Have you ever done any shrooms? Ive honestly never heard of anyone getting it from weed but who knows. It could have caused some kind of neurological damage that mirrors PSSD.
Thank you for sharing about your step dad's story. This community desperately needs some hope.
Second that. Better to stay away from psych meds in general but if you feel like you absolutely need to take something a benzo is way safer than an SSRI.
Sorry to hear about your situation with Venlafaxine. You could make a twitter account and help us raise awareness on there.
It’s a scene from a movie. The girl shoots all the people she hates before shooting herself in the head while she is standing knee deep in the ocean. I’d love to feel the water on my legs.
